raw_value_json: "Outturn data in this table up to 2025-26 fall within the scope of Accredited Official Statistics"

"(1) Real terms figures are the nominal figures adjusted to 2025-26 price levels using GDP deflators from the Office for National Statistics (released 30 June 2026) and deflator forecasts from the Office for Budget Responsibility (Economic and fiscal outlook - 3 March 2026)."

"(2) GDP until 2025-26 is consistent with the latest figures from the Office for National Statistics (published 30 June 2026). GDP forecasts from 2026-27 onwards are from the Office for Budget Responsibility (Economic and fiscal outlook - 3 March 2026)."
"(3) This excludes the temporary effects of banks being classified to the public sector."
